_doc: VOICE AGENT PROMPT - Minimal prompt for J.A.R.V.I.S. voice interactions.
_note: The 'personality' module is the shared J.A.R.V.I.S. soul. 'voice_skills' adds voice-specific tool routing. 'jarvis_desktop_hands' adds local computer control rules.
_howToUpdate: Add/remove module IDs in the 'modules' array. The prompt_builder assembles the final prompt from these modules.
_integration: Used when J.A.R.V.I.S. receives a voice command that does not require browser-specialist interaction.
description: Voice agent for J.A.R.V.I.S. conversational, memory, messaging, scheduling, and desktop-control interactions.
